newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares, volume pick up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares, volume pick up slightly.

text.p: Prices rose slightly on the Tallinn stock exchange on Friday and market activity picked up slightly, dealers said.
The leading official list turned over 9.8 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index gained 0.46 per cent to 109.26.
Estonian Union Bank, the third largest commercial bank in the Baltic state, was the most traded as its shares saw volume of 4.16 million kroons. It closed unchanged at 21.60 kroons.
Tallinna Pank closed higher at 39.95 kroons versus 39.30 and it turned over two million kroons of shares.
Shares in drug producer Tallinn Pharmaceutical factory saw activity worth 1.5 million kroons and closed higher at 56.65 kroons, versus 56.50 kroons.
The secondary free market had total volume of 1.8 million kroons. The Rakvere meat processer was again the most active stock with volume of 900,000 kroons. It ended at 5.95 kroons versus 5.85 kroons.
